headline: Man United 'made the most' of money available with transfers - Michael Carrick
description: Michael Carrick has said he's "largely happy" with Manchester United's summer transfer business and insisted the club have "made the most" of the money they had available.

headline: Yankuba Minteh can 'fulfil his dream' next year after Liverpool bid rejected - Brighton boss
description: Brighton head coach Fabian Hurzeler has challenged Yankuba Minteh to help Brighton succeed before earning a dream transfer move.

headline: Frank Lampard: Coventry must learn to recover from 'difficult result'
description: Coventry City boss Frank Lampard says his side will have to get used to that losing feeling this season.

headline: Newcastle 'counting' on Man United target Lewis Hall long-term - Matthias Jaissle
description: Matthias Jaissle is braced for more suitors to sniff around Lewis Hall this winter but the Newcastle head coach is optimistic that the left-back will have a long-lasting future at the club.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Trabzonspor eye Richarlison move on deadline day
description: Richarlison is a target for Turkish side Trabzonspor after the Tottenham forward was left out of the team's Premier League squad. Transfer Talk has the latest.
